actor_output.character_response: Oh, it was the most magical moment! I felt a tingle, like a warm breeze on a chilly day, and suddenly, there I was, all snow and joy! I looked around and thought, 'Wow, I’m alive!' It was like waking up from a dream, and I couldn't help but giggle at the sparkles all around me. Everything felt so new and exciting, like I was meant to dance in the snow forever!
